evaluation_scope: software simulation and local API timing

cryptographic_performance.measurement_method: local wall-clock SecureChannel API timing using time.perf_counter_ns
cryptographic_performance.encryption_timing_note: Includes persistent SQLite nonce allocation and packet envelope construction.
cryptographic_performance.decryption_timing_note: Measures authenticated decryption of the actual Phase 4 encrypted packets.

limitations: Encryption and decryption timings are local software wall-clock measurements and vary by computer load and hardware.
Encryption timing includes persistent SQLite nonce allocation and envelope construction.
Phase 5 energy figures are illustrative simulation estimates, not physical hardware measurements.
Classification counts are descriptive only; accuracy, precision, recall and F1 require ground-truth labels.
No physical radio, sensor battery, or agricultural field deployment was measured.
